description:
Are you an experienced and compassionate Registered Nurse leader looking for a pivotal role in a skilled nursing facility? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA, is seeking a dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead their clinical team. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and maintaining regulatory compliance. You will play a crucial role in fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff, driving continuous improvement in clinical outcomes.

This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment. Join a team dedicated to providing outstanding care and support to the community.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Experience working in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year.

roleTitle: Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate leader to contribute to a supportive environment focused on resident care and staff development. We are actively looking to fill this vital role.

As the ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations, ensuring high standards of care, and supporting the Director of Nursing. This position offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to quality healthcare.

If you are an RN with leadership experience in a skilled nursing setting and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Prior experience as an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) or similar leadership role
Clinical experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS, as a dedicated MDS Coordinator. This full-time role offers a vital opportunity to ensure accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, playing a crucial part in resident care planning and regulatory compliance. We are seeking a professional who is passionate about quality care and meticulous in their work.In this position, you will collaborate closely with our interdisciplinary team to gather comprehensive resident information, ensuring all documentation meets federal and state guidelines. Your expertise will directly impact our residents' care plans and the facility's operational excellence. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00 for this essential role.
requirements: Minimum of 1-2 years experience with MDS 3.0
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) - RN to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a unique opportunity for a committed nursing leader to make a lasting impact within a supportive and dynamic environment.As the ADON, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and supporting the Director of Nursing. This permanent, full-time position offers stability and the chance to build long-term relationships with residents and staff, contributing significantly to the facility's success and reputation for excellence.If you are an RN with proven leadership abilities and a passion for geriatric care, we invite you to apply. Join a team that values your expertise and dedication, offering a rewarding career path in a facility committed to quality outcomes.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, such as ADON or Nurse Supervisor
Demonstrated commitment to a permanent, full-time employment opportunity
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and organizational skills
